summary: Ebang International Holdings, through its U.S. subsidiary, completed acquisition of 461-acre property in Grover, North Carolina on August 5, 2026, for approximately US$24.6 million. The deal includes real estate and appurtenances with customary representations and termination provisions. The acquisition aims to enhance U.S. operational capabilities and explore new business growth. This is a completed asset purchase disclosed on Form 6-K, with the full agreement filed as Exhibit 10.1. What to watch: integration risks and potential follow-on capital raises given the strategic repositioning toward U.S. real estate.
